infoHeroTitle: A digital themed trail for St. Georgen im Schwarzwald
infoHeroSubtitle: St.GeoARgen is a student project created as part of studies at the IIIUS Institut of Hochschule Furtwangen University (HFU). The application turns a classic city walk into an interactive AR experience with digital information, game mechanics, and 3D content.
infoHighlight1Text: St.GeoARgen runs directly in the browser as a Progressive Web App and requires no installation.
infoHighlight2Text: QR codes at selected locations lead visitors to digital content, interactive tasks, and 3D experiences.
infoHighlight3Text: Points, rewards, and progress indicators increase motivation and turn the city tour into a playful experience.
infoWhyText: The goal of the project is to present the history, culture, and nature of St. Georgen in a playful way while also supporting tourism, the city center, and local partners.
infoPillar1Text: The app connects real-world places in St. Georgen with digital information, images, and 3D content.
infoPillar2Text: The implementation is structured so that additional stations and content can be added later.
infoPillar3Text: History, culture, and nature are presented in a playful way, especially for younger audiences and tourists.
infoProcess1: A storyboard and user flow were created and visualized at the beginning.
infoProcess2: Design decisions for the interface, mascot, and signage supported an intuitive experience.
infoProcess3: The web app was implemented with geolocated AR functions, user management, and gamification.
infoProcess4: Station-specific 3D models were created and integrated into the application.
infoResult1: With St.GeoARgen, a working digital themed trail with multiple AR stations has been created, guiding visitors through St. Georgen and extending traditional information boards with immersive digital content.
infoResult2: The modular architecture makes it possible to expand the trail with additional stations and content in the future and continue the city’s digital development.
infoFooterNote: Student project created as part of studies at IIIUS Institut of HFU
